owner_source.source_scope: Owner asks to trace and continue the previously implemented Mission Control failure-capture mechanism rather than substituting ChatGPT Memory.

parent_owner_outcome.remaining_gap: A fresh owner-reported Mission Control improvement/failure still has not traversed an automatically activated ordinary-Chat capture path into durable Mission Control/GitHub state without the owner having to rediscover or restate the mechanism.

normalized_outcome: When the owner explicitly identifies a reasoning, instruction-following, routing, or execution failure as a Mission Control example, asks to save/record it, or asks to recover prior examples, the active Chat must route that intent to durable Mission Control/GitHub evidence at the actual destination. Conversation context, ChatGPT Memory, templates, or a merely available event schema do not count as capture. Recovery must distinguish exact source evidence from bounded summaries and must not publish sensitive/private material merely to preserve a failure example.

required_outcomes.observable: A live owner-explicit Mission Control failure-capture trigger activates a durable GitHub/runtime write in the same task when an authorized write route is available, before the assistant claims the failure is saved.

The durable record preserves the bounded correction/failure mechanism, source digest/provenance, and recovery quality without leaking secrets, private chat locators, private infrastructure identifiers, or sensitive personal content into the public repository.

When earlier examples are recovered, exact quotes and bounded summaries/partial recoveries are labeled distinctly and existing durable records are deduplicated rather than recreated as invented exact evidence.
Owner-facing status distinguishes NOT_DURABLE, CAPTURED_BRANCH_ONLY, CANONICAL, and PARTIAL_RECOVERY; a schema/template/intent/memory statement cannot be reported as durable capture.

A later fresh ordinary Chat turn with an explicit owner capture instruction demonstrates end-to-end activation and durable capture without relying on the owner to remember a repository branch, template, or special Mission Control-only chat.
